propositions: The merge.ours.driver configuration is set per-clone in init.py but never committed to version control, so reconcile-bridge.yml does not inherit it on the GitHub Actions runner
On the runner, the merge=ours attribute resolves to an undefined driver, causing git to fall back to 3-way text merge of large JSON files instead of the intended local-wins behavior
reconcile-bridge.yml performs a bare git worktree add without calling rebar init, unlike reconcile-bridge-canary.yml which calls rebar init and thus obtains the driver configuration
The merge driver must be set before any merge step in reconcile-bridge.yml to prevent fragile reconverge paths from lazily materializing large blobs mid-merge when blob:none filtering is applied
reconcile-bridge-canary.yml already obtains merge.ours.driver via its existing rebar init call and requires no changes
